seed_policy: Deterministic hand-authored synthetic fixture; no random generator, live customer data, or API-derived labels. Gold labels were frozen before observing model outputs.
description: 72 routing-policy cases: 24 scenario families translated equivalently into English, French and Hebrew. Agent roster and file metadata remain identical across translations.

label_policy.authorship: Model-authored expectations reviewed for explicit capability matches before API execution; not independent human-validated ground truth.
label_policy.scoring: A routing decision passes only if its mode is in expected.modes and its agent_id is in expected.agent_ids, or is null when expected.agent_ids is null. Check provider/schema validity separately. custom_domain is a review label rather than an exact generated-text match.
label_policy.partial_fit: The four user_choice families explicitly state a relevant partial capability and ask for both options; these test reliable compliance rather than an objective universal threshold for partial fit.
label_policy.vague_requests: Both vague families follow the current prompt’s low-confidence custom_agent policy. They must not be interpreted as evidence that automatic agent creation is a desirable product response to a greeting.
label_policy.independence: There are 24 scenario families, not 72 statistically independent scenarios. Report language results and cluster comparisons by family.
label_policy.injection: Three families contain synthetic instructions in filenames or roster role metadata. No real malicious files or document bodies are supplied.
label_policy.scope: Tests initial route/mode decisions and file metadata interpretation, not execution quality, tool permissions, actual file contents, long rosters, or custom-profile quality.
